Method of Attack: Remote Code Execution (RCE) via ClassLoader manipulation and Tomcat context reconfiguration
Impacted Systems: Spring Web applications running on Java 9 and later with Tomcat
Attack Vector: POST requests with POJOs to trigger binding, ClassLoader manipulation, Tomcat context reconfiguration
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious JSP files created in Tomcat's web application root, arbitrary log file configurations
